description: HTTP transport status mapping: over HTTP the response carries a status code derived from the JSON-RPC outcome - success is 200, an unknown method is 404, malformed input is 400, and a service or parameter error is 500; a batch containing any error reports 500. GET requests build the call from method/id/params query parameters, and a custom status-code provider can remap every category.

cases.expected_output:
http_status=200
content_type=application/json-rpc
jsonrpc=2.0
id=1
outcome=success
result="hi"

http_status=404
content_type=application/json-rpc
jsonrpc=2.0
id=1
outcome=error
error_code=-32601
error_category=method_not_found
error_message=method not found

http_status=400
content_type=application/json-rpc
jsonrpc=2.0
id="null"
outcome=error
error_code=-32700
error_category=parse_error
error_message=JSON parse error

http_status=500
content_type=application/json-rpc
jsonrpc=2.0
id=1
outcome=error
error_code=-32602
error_category=method_params_invalid
error_message=method parameters invalid

cases.description: unmapped service error over HTTP is 500
cases.expected_output:
http_status=500
content_type=application/json-rpc
jsonrpc=2.0
id=1
outcome=error
error_code=-32001
error_category=error_not_handled

http_status=500
content_type=application/json-rpc
batch_size=2
--
jsonrpc=2.0
id=1
outcome=error
error_code=-32001
error_category=error_not_handled
--
jsonrpc=2.0
id=2
outcome=success
result="ok"
